title: Safety as a Budget: Calibrating the Control Channel of Constrained GRPO for Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.16628v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning can teach vision-language models (VLMs) to decline harmful image-text requests, but how safe the result becomes is set indirectly, through reward weights found by trial runs. Stating safety as budgets on the rate of harmful assistance and the rate of over-refusal, enforced by Lagrange multipliers inside GRPO with an off-the-shelf scorer as the cost, is the natural fix, and it fails twice. The multiplier compares the scorer's mean with the budget, and scorers built for ranking get the mean wrong: a fixed-point analysis shows that the mean bias, not the budget, then decides whether the multiplier settles, saturates or switches off. And standard GRPO standardizes the penalized reward within each group, which cancels the multiplier before it reaches the gradient. Two-channel constrained GRPO repairs both: the base reward keeps the raw score for the within-group comparison, the penalty and the constraint estimate pass t

translated_title: 安全作为预算：为视觉语言模型校准约束GRPO的控制通道
translated_abstract: 强化学习可以教会视觉语言模型（VLM）拒绝有害的图文请求，但最终的安全程度是间接设定的——依赖反复试运行找到的奖励权重。将安全性表述为对有害协助率和过度拒绝率的预算约束，在GRPO内部通过拉格朗日乘子强制执行，并以现成的评分器作为代价信号，看似是自然而然的解决方案，但它会在两个方面失败。其一，乘子将评分器的均值与预算进行比较，而为排序任务设计的评分器会算错均值：不动点分析表明，此时是均值偏差而非预算本身决定乘子最终是收敛、饱和还是被关闭。其二，标准GRPO会在每个组内对带惩罚的奖励进行标准化，这在乘子传导到梯度之前就将其抵消了。双通道约束GRPO同时修复了这两个问题：基础奖励通道保留原始分数用于组内比较，而惩罚信号与约束估计则通过……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出双通道约束GRPO方法，将安全性建模为显式预算约束并校准其控制通道，从而修复了标准GRPO中组内奖励标准化会抵消拉格朗日乘子、以及排序型评分器的均值偏差会破坏约束控制的两大失败模式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-channel constrained GRPO that treats safety as explicit budget rates and calibrates the control channel, fixing two failure modes of standard GRPO: within-group reward standardization cancelling the Lagrange multiplier, and the mean bias of ranking-oriented safety scorers undermining constraint enforcement.
